evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: If a need for improvement is indicated by the evaluator, the evaluator or his/her designee shall provide affirmative assistance in an effort to improve the teacher’s performance. Such assistance shall include, but not be limited to, a demonstration lesson and a supply of the appropriate resource material, if requested.

evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: Section 41.1.1.10 states that if a teacher “Does Not Meet Standards,” “either non-reelection or termination is possible.” Section 37.1 gives summer school priority to teachers with “satisfactory or better evaluations.” Section 29.1.1.2 requires evaluations rated “better than satisfactory” for probationary appointment eligibility. Section 28.8.4 gives priority for open positions to substitutes without an “unsatisfactory evaluation.”
